title: Lucky Luke: End of Legend
overview: Lucky Luke: End of Legend is a short fan film based on Lucky Luke's french comics. This short film in motion comic style inspired by pop art was made to convey the feeling of a live comic. It was published in two ways, traditional and animated in 2022, directed by Amirhossein Jafari along with a book version and it was registered as the first fully comic short work in Iran.
